method: Exploratory prepared native font-cost prescreen only; unchanged old screen.py and executable. Preserve all rejected fonts. Analyze each profile/DPR separately: per-case trial medians followed by median of five logical sizes. DPR1 outlines match actual first-paint 11/12/14/15/16px sizes; DPR2 outlines are 22/24/28/30/32px. No confidence intervals, cache overhead, predicted application savings or percentage claims.
